mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (relative to historical averages) compresses the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and an increase in non-farm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of PAYEMS increasing and UNRATE decreasing fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a housing starts level below 1400 thousand units and a retail sales level below 380 billion dollars signal weakening consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400 and RSAFS < 380000 during a late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC for the joint condition falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher housing starts level (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand and construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in strong economic fundamentals.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing production index (INDPRO) below 110.0 signals a contraction in industrial output, reducing corporate profits and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) and a decline in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint low level of INDPRO and GDPC1 fails to produce negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals labor market weakness and slowing economic growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% during a late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
